run_train_video_classification_model: run the MemViT training job for a video classification model using a config file
run_test_video_classification_model: run the MemViT multi-clip testing job for a video classification model using a config file
run_train_and_test: run both training and testing for a MemViT video classification model in one command
parse_args_memvit: parse command-line arguments for the MemViT training and testing wrapper script
load_config_memvit: load and validate the MemViT configuration from a YAML config file
